description: Map each tool to the scopes that authorise it and flag tools with no scope. When reviewing which tools an agent may call and under what scope. Do not choose this when you need enforcement, which needs the runtime. Example requests: Build a permission matrix for these tools and scopes. | Which tools have no scope? | Map my agent tools to their permissions.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

scopes.description: The customer's scopes.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Scope names, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

tools.description: The customer's tools.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Tool names, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

title: Tool permission matrix
